description: Car parking fee income is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by North Somerset Council. Car parking fee income from April 2011 to present. NB Car parking fee income figures do not reflect the monthly takings in car parks but cash collection and reconciliation. Coverage: North Somerset Council. The portal files it under the publisher North Somerset Council. The portal shows 2026-07-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
